messages:
zoe_sec: Heads-up: planning a micro-rebase of base-image at 01:30 UTC to fold in a libc backport and a small layer prune. Need a 2h KMS signer window + RBAC sanity before push. Who can own key alias and sink check?

ash_infra: I got key alias + sink. Will create cosign alias 'cosign-micro-2801' and bind 2h to sa-rebuild-micro@redwood-infra. Minimal roles only: roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeySigner + roles/cloudkms.viewer. Ill dry-run in staging.

oli_runtime: Ill patch the GH workflow to use workload identity mapping to the ephemeral sa and limit to roles/redwood.rebuildMicro. Ill add cosign verify step after push.

tom_oncall: Ill open #release-war-room and watch logging. Need confirmation KMS sign and GCR push export to logs-to-splunk-prod (admin_activity + data_access) within 10m.

audit-bot: audit-bot: scheduled sink-check: logs-to-splunk-prod includes: protoPayload.methodName matches (google.cloud.kms.v1.KeyManagementService.AsymmetricSign, google.devtools.containeranalysis.v1alpha1.AnalyzePackages)

zoe_sec: Checklist after push: 1) cosign verify OK against gcpkms://projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/rebuild/cryptoKeys/cosign-micro-2801 2) ./scripts/smoke-canary.sh micro-2801234567 passes 3) KMS sign + GCR push show in sink within 10m 4) verify pipeline SA has no broad roles (no storage.admin/container.admin)

ash_infra: Dry-run completed. Command Ill run: `gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding cosign-micro-2801 --keyring=rebuild --location=global --member="serviceAccount:sa-rebuild-micro@redwood-infra" --role="roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeySigner"` (then revoke after window).

oli_runtime: PR: https://github.com/redwood/base-image/pull/520 adds workload identity + cosign verify step. Using short-lived token in job.

audit-bot: audit-bot: dry-run sinks ok. Will notify when production events land.

ash_infra: Binding granted at T-10m. Canary build queued tag=micro-2801234567 sha=beef01

audit-bot: audit-bot: build pushed & signed; cosign-log-id=cosign-2801234567

oli_runtime: Smoke: startup 78ms, /health OK, kv warm. cosign verify returned OK. Logs & KMS sign appear in sink (auditIDs: AID-2801-01).

tom_oncall: Observability green. Revoking binding now.

ash_infra: Binding revoked. No unexpected IAM grants.

zoe_sec: Nice work. Ill post a short post-run summary with cosign id and auditIDs. Leaving thread open 30m then marking canary-success.
